steps.name: Following the Flowers (1)
steps.objective: Meet [Adrian] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」 and choose (Recent Rumors) from the Talk menu. When the conversation ends, turn in the quest to [Adrian].

lines.text: (A warm breeze brushes past %s while you look around Glaston's central plaza. A flower petal, perhaps carried on that breeze, falls before %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did it come from? The fragrance is wonderful...
(Your feet move naturally, drawn by the gentle scent. A few steps later, you see a flower stall welcoming customers.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, so this is where it came from.
(A young man sitting behind the stall's cart rises, apparently noticing your approach.)
Oh, hello...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello... I noticed a floral scent from somewhere and followed it here...
Was the fragrance strong enough to travel that far?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rather than strong... How should I put it? There was a fresh scent like fruit juice, and something that tickled my nose like a rich perfume...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was also a scent like something I'd smelled by the sea.
(The expressionless young man looks slightly surprised by %s's words.)
...You identified the scents of all three kinds of flowers I brought today. That's impressive.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, did I? Maybe it's just because I like all flowers.
(The young man smiles lightly and introduces himself.)

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: I'm Adrian. I bring flowers I've grown myself at my nursery and sell them here. But I don't think I've seen you in the plaza before...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. This is my first visit to Glaston.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: If you don't mind, could you tell me your name?

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: What a lovely name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seems Adrian hasn't heard the rumors about me.)

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: You don't seem to be looking for flowers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I'm working on something and asking people a few questions...

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: It's all right. Please go ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Adrian.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Rumors...? Let's see. Hmm...

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Would something like this help? I overheard some children buying flowers. They said strange sounds have been coming from their neighborhood...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you tell me more?

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Yes... There is a street called LaChouette, which people in Glaston regard as the slums.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: It's a little gloomy because it lies lower than areas like the central plaza and the residential district. That doesn't mean the people there are gloomy, though.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Anyway... At night, from deep inside LaChouette, toward a disused waterway, they hear this sound.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: 'I want to get out, I want to get out...' Someone sobs those words, but when they go closer, they can't hear anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (They want to get out...?)

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: A few curious children sneaked into the waterway to explore without telling the adults, but they found nothing.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: It's very strange...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The waterway in the LaChouette slums? Hmm...)

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Please don't take it too seriously. Rumors often turn out to be nothing more than rumors...

steps.name: Following the Flowers (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Adrian] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」, then use the Gather skill on the flower cart to obtain a <Flower from Adrian's Garden>. Then turn in the quest to [Edel] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Was that helpful?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Those words, 'I want to get out'... Surely...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Adrian.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Are you a detective or a troubleshooter?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I do something similar.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: I hope it isn't dangerous...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure it isn't the sort of bad thing you're imagining.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: That's a relief.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, what is this pink flower? It's the only one whose scent I can't detect.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: It's called Romeria. It has almost no fragrance, so it's often used for decoration.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: I found that strange at first too, but it makes sense when you think about the environment it grows in.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: A flower that blooms in winter must endure the cold to greet the warmth of spring. Sometimes I wonder if its fragrance fades away while it weathers that harsh winter...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Because it passes through winter to welcome spring, it symbolizes new encounters.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: I often give one to people I meet for the first time, hoping they'll remember me fondly. Would... that be all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. Thank you, Adrian.
(Adrian smiles brightly at %s's delight in receiving the flower. Then he spots someone passing by and calls out loudly.)

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Edel! Edel!

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Oh... She's gone. She must not have heard me. When you asked about rumors, I thought Edel might be able to help.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: She's very bright and knows all sorts of things. Sometimes she even gives me advice. There are times she seems more grown-up than I am.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: She seems to be out for a walk. Would you like to talk with her?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go talk to her.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Oh, Edel loves the flowers from Adrian's Flower Garden. Could you take a few from the cart and give them to her? Don't feel you owe me anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Yes, of course. I have all the flowers I could need.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Adrian. I'll go meet Edel. Now, which flowers would she like?

steps.name: Following the Flowers (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Edel] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」, then obtain a <Black Bone> in 「Gate of Lysithea」. Then turn in the quest to [Edel] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」.

lines.text: (A little girl who was humming looks around at the sound of someone calling her.)
Did I imagine that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Adrian called you. You're Edel, right?
(The girl gives a suspicious look when a stranger says her name.)
And who might you be? You've even brought flowers. Are you here to confess your love?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Confess my love? Oh, no, nothing like that.
I'm joking.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right. Let me introduce myself first. That should ease your suspicions, shouldn't it?
(Edel looks slightly surprised when the adventurer gives their name.)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Are you that adventurer? The one who recently rescued the people stranded on Aie Island...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know me?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Of course. Hardly anyone in Glaston doesn't know your name, %s. Except Mr. Adrian.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... He really didn't.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I thought so. He has no interest in anything but flowers. %s, those flowers are for me, aren't they?
(Edel accepts the flowers from %s and smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Thank you. I'm Edel. You know the flower edelweiss? That's the Edel in my name.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: If Mr. Adrian called me, it must mean he wanted me to talk with you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know...?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I love flowers, so he must have asked you to bring them to me. Hehe. So, %s, what would you like to talk about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, so this is why he said she seems grown-up.)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you heard any strange rumors in Glaston lately?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Let's see... %s, give me a moment... May I sit down for a little while?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I feel a little dizzy...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Edel, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I'll be fine if I sit for a bit. I'm rather frail, so this happens sometimes.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Ten years ago, I had a fever that nearly killed me, apparently. Honestly, I don't remember it well, but I held on, and I'm all right now.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I've recovered enough to take walks with Mendelsmann XIV.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mendelsmann XIV? Who's that?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: He's our black dog, as big as a bear. He isn't really a bear, though.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: My grandfather's grandfather, and his grandfather's grandfather... One of my ancestors had a dog, and our family has kept raising its descendants.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Our current Mendelsmann is the fourteenth generation. He seems unhappy lately.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: He must have lost the toy he carried around every day. He went into his doghouse and won't come out.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I bought him new toys, but he doesn't seem to like them. Aww...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... So getting him a good toy would help move our conversation along.
(Edel nods at %s's response with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I'll wait here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel like I've been played... Hmm. What would make a good toy for a huge dog?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The only dog I've seen recently was Hellfire inside Lysithea's gate... I should go look around there for something.)
(Edel tilts her head at the enormous black bone she receives from %s.)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: What an enormous, hard stick. Where did you find it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...It's a toy that a demonic beast... I mean, a really big dog played with somewhere I visited before. It looked abandoned, so I picked it up.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I think Mendelsmann will love it. Thank you. In return, I've learned a few things from the children.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: If you, the person at the center of all the rumors, act openly, it could cause a stir, %s.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: For example, among people who don't think very highly of you, %s...

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: While you were getting Mendelsmann's toy, %s, I asked the children I look after at the daycare for help. They had some interesting stories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, I never imagined she'd arranged this deliberately...)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: What are you thinking?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing. Thank you, Edel.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Oh, there was something I wanted to ask you, %s... Do you know Professor Theodore? He's my teacher, and he often tells me about you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course I know Professor Theo well. He's helped me a great deal. What has he been saying?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Even after he went to Esnil, he sends me things to study by letter.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Recently, he said you took part in the Battle of Moros, %s, and sent me piles of material about Freios and Eastland. About sixty pages this time, I think...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, I see.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Now you'd like to hear the children's stories, right? Whose sounds most interesting?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm... Which story should I hear first?)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: A loves playing with the younger children, so he takes a whole group of them all over the place.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Glaston is huge, isn't it? But there's nowhere he hasn't been. He runs around the plaza and even the administrative district.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: He was running through LaChouette Street when he entered an alley with a very strange atmosphere. An older boy with animal ears, like a beastfolk, was lying there wearing only trousers.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: He looked as though he was about to die, so A gave him the bread he'd saved for later. Then something like a golem behind him came over and thanked him.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: He asked where there were lots of clothes, then flew away riding the golem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...That sounds like No Name... If it's true, he was somewhere in LaChouette...)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: B likes to go out into the yard alone and stare blankly at the sky.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: She was out there again at nap time, so I asked what she was doing...

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: And she said she'd seen a flying dolphin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A dolphin?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I asked how she could see a dolphin when this wasn't the sea...

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: She said a pink dolphin greeted her and flew off toward LaChouette Street.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I asked whether the other children had seen it, but none of them knew anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What could a flying pink dolphin be?)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: My best friend C has been a little strange since we were small. Though we're still small, and she's still strange.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Her late grandmother was a well-known fortune-teller in Glaston. C takes after her and is very good with tarot. I suppose you'd say she has a strong intuition...

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: A little while ago, she was telling fortunes in the plaza when everything around her suddenly went dark.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: She looked around, wondering what was happening, then felt something above her head and looked up...

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: It was Glaston.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She was in Glaston, with another Glaston above her?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I didn't see it myself, so I can't be certain. C said it felt as though there was another world in the sky.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: She was so startled that she ran all over the place. Then she saw a monster about twice as tall as a person.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: She was too frightened to move. The monster asked if she was the one who had awakened it, and she desperately said no.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Then the monster said, 'Go, then,' and approached. She was so scared she closed her eyes without thinking.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened next?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: She heard running water and opened her eyes to find herself back in the plaza where she'd been reading tarot. I don't know how much of it is true.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: The people in front of her couldn't understand why she was so frightened, so they called her parents.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: C's parents said her grandmother often saw things like that, so C must take after her.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: So C is resting at home now. Seeing such a healthy girl stuck indoors reminds me of how I used to be. I feel sorry for her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm. What on earth did that child see?)

choices.text: 4. Boy D, age 13, aspiring dark mage

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Maybe it's puberty, but D has been lost in his own little world lately.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: When you speak to him, he says things like, 'Mortal, you have done well to survive with such a paltry soul. What do you seek of me?'

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Then the other children get offended and scold him. He's softhearted, so he says sorry. But it doesn't last long before he starts again.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: He goes on about Megiddo, Pandemonium, and a black dragon. I couldn't understand any of it, so I asked Professor Theodore, and he explained.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I know Pandemonium, but what was Megiddo again...?)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Apparently Pandemonium is a major city in the Demon Realm, like Glaston...

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: He thought Megiddo might have existed so long ago that even today's demons know little about it.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Anyway, he said the things D was saying were bad and insisted I stop him using those words. I just finished scolding him again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did D hear those things?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Once, the children got lost on a field trip to the Magic Bureau. He overheard the mages who helped them find their way and thought it sounded cool, so he copied them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What were those mages doing, to talk about things like that...?)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Thank you for listening. Honestly, I thought you might not pay much attention to children's stories...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm the one who should thank you. It helped a lot.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I think I should go home now. I'll put Mr. Adrian's flowers in a pretty vase and make sure Mendelsmann gets his toy.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: See you later, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye, Edel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm... I need to sort through the stories Edel told me.)
